proposed.text: When pressure-treated wood is used in enclosed locations where drying in service cannot readily occur, what moisture content is required before it is covered?

rationale.correct: Section 605.10 requires such treated wood to have moisture content of 19 percent or less before being covered with insulation, interior finish, floor covering, or other materials.
rationale.c: Not selected: No limit if pressure-treated
